records.text: Owens corrected her earlier account and said Deputy Secretary of Defense Stephen Feinberg sits between Bradley Hansell and Pete Hegseth in the Defense Department reporting chain.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: We initially told you that Bradley Hansell reports directly to Pete Hegseth, the secretary of war. But actually, we weren't entirely correct. ... There was one man in between Bradley and Pete Hegseth. A man named Stephen Feinberg, who occupies the position of Deputy Secretary of Defense.

verification.notes: Official Defense Department sources identify Pete Hegseth as Secretary, Stephen Feinberg as Deputy Secretary, and Bradley Hansell as Under Secretary for Intelligence and Security. The organization hierarchy supports Feinberg sitting between the Secretary and the Under Secretary.

sources.title: Deputy Secretary of Defense
sources.relevance: Officially identifies Stephen Feinberg as the deputy secretary in the Defense Department hierarchy.

sources.title: Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security Leadership
sources.relevance: Officially identifies Bradley Hansell as the intelligence and security under secretary.

records.text: Owens said Stephen Feinberg was the wealthiest person in the Trump administration, with a net worth of about five billion dollars.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: What we can state definitively is that he is the wealthiest person in the Trump (Donald Trump) administration. I always find it a little weird when you got somebody who's like worth five billion like this guy

verification.notes: Contemporary wealth reporting estimates Feinberg at about 5 billion dollars, supporting the amount. The superlative is not supported: published administration wealth lists include people with higher estimates, including Elon Musk while serving as a special government employee and officials such as Howard Lutnick.

records.text: Owens said Stephen Feinberg co-founded Cerberus Capital Management in 1992, that it managed 70 billion dollars in assets, and that DynCorp entered its portfolio in 2010.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Well, in 1992, he co-founded Cerberus Capital Management. ... Cerberus Capital Management is a fund with 70 billion AUM. That's assets that are under their management, 70 billion. ... Steven Feinberg was one half. He's a co-founder and that's why he was a controversial pick, not just because of his extraordinary wealth, but more specifically due to one particular asset which came under their management portfolio in 2010, DynCorp.

verification.notes: Official Defense and Cerberus materials confirm Feinberg co-founded Cerberus in 1992, that the firm grew to approximately 70 billion dollars in assets under his leadership, and that Cerberus affiliates completed the DynCorp acquisition in July 2010.

sources.title: Hon. Steve Feinberg official biography
sources.relevance: Confirms the 1992 Cerberus co-founding and approximately 70 billion dollars in assets under his leadership.

sources.relevance: Confirms completion of the DynCorp acquisition in July 2010.

records.text: Owens said Stephen Feinberg owned a private military company from 2010 through 2020 and joined the first Trump administration in 2017.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Anyway, I'm overstating that so that you understand why Stephen Feinberg, outright owning a military mercenary group from 2010 through to 2020, he joined Trump (Donald Trump) administration in 2017, the first go around

verification.notes: Cerberus affiliates acquired DynCorp in 2010 and sold it to Amentum in 2020, supporting the ownership period through the firm Feinberg led. Feinberg was discussed for an intelligence role in 2017 but his formal chairmanship of the President Intelligence Advisory Board began in 2018, so the asserted 2017 entry is imprecise.

records.text: Owens said Stephen Feinberg claimed to have divested from Cerberus Capital Management but alleged that he still had unclear financial ties to it.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I know since Stephen Feinberg. ... has said that he has divested from Cerberus Capital, but that kind of always just means like it's on hold and he still does have financial ties to them, which are unclear.

verification.notes: Official ethics documents and a 2026 Senate oversight letter show Feinberg certified divestment of Cerberus stakes while retaining or amending arrangements for Cerberus administrative services and family trusts. The public record supports the stated unresolved continuing ties caveat.
